description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ParsesIniTrait' within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods to load AWS configuration profiles from ini files and retrieve the user's home directory across different operating systems.

classes.name: ParsesIniTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait that provides methods for parsing AWS credentials and configuration ini files, as well as retrieving user home directory.

methods.name: loadProfiles
methods.description: Loads AWS profiles from a specified ini file, merging with user config if present, and standardizing profile names.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Returns the user's home directory path across different operating systems, or null if not determinable.
